Q1 2027 Financial Highlights
Cash Position:
Ended the quarter with $16.6 million in cash, compared to $18.9 million as of June 30, 2026.
Working Capital:
Maintained positive working capital of $15.2 million as of September 30, 2026.
Net Loss:
Recorded a net loss of $2.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 ($(0.00) per share) compared to net loss of $4.1 million during the comparative period last year ($(0.01) per share).

Q1 2027 Operational Highlights & Outlook
State Infrastructure Grant:
The Company announced final approval by the Michigan Strategic Fund of $50 million in performance-based grant funding under the Strategic Site Readiness Program (“
SSRP
“) to support the development of the Company’s permitted Copperwood Project and related infrastructure improvements in Gogebic County, Michigan. The grant consists of:
US$45.0 million to Copperwood Resources Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Highland Copper, to support eligible infrastructure expenditures associated with the development of Copperwood; and
US$5.0 million to the Gogebic County Road Commission to support critical local infrastructure improvements associated with the Project and benefiting the broader region.
In addition to the SSRP funding, the Gogebic County Road Commission has secured a $7.5 million Transportation Economic Development Fund (“
TEDF
“) Category A grant from the Michigan Department of Transportation (“
MDOT

Subsequent to quarter-end, Copperwood Resources Inc. concluded the formal grant agreement with the Michigan Strategic Fund. The grant is conditional upon the Company providing evidence, on or before March 31, 2028, that it has obtained commitments satisfactory to the MEDC for US$150,000,000 in additional project financing (the “
Project Milestone

”). Once the Company demonstrates that it has met the Project Milestone, it will be eligible for reimbursement of expenditures made on or before March 31, 2033, on site preparation and improvement necessary to support the development of the Project. The grant is subject to certain completion milestones, including that the Company has established a minimum of 380 qualified jobs at the Project.
Wetland Delineation and Permitting:

As disclosed in the Management's Discussion and Analysis for the year ended June 30, 2026, the Company initiated a wetland delineation survey to inform whether a supplemental permit may be appropriate before construction. Given the passage of time since the original wetland delineation and permit, it was considered prudent to determine if new wetland had emerged that required permitting. Through this exercise, it was determined there is a modest amount of acreage that will require a supplemental Part 303 Wetland Protection permit. This is consistent with the assessment by Michigan's Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy. It is anticipated that the formal wetland delineation will conclude in Q2 2027 with a goal of receiving the permit by Q4 2027.
Environmental Stewardship and Site Work:

Continued early site work and environmental mitigation activities, including stream and wetland mitigation, revegetation, corrective work, and ongoing monitoring and maintenance. The Company also completed an off-site bridge replacement on budget and on time as a stream mitigation project and is in process to establish a 717-acre wetland preservation area.
Integrated Mine Plan Review:

Advanced the Integrated Mine Plan Review, including refinement of mine design criteria, mine design and production scheduling, geotechnical assumptions, infrastructure and equipment requirements, and operating cost estimates. The work is intended to optimize the Copperwood mine plan and establish an updated technical and cost basis for subsequent project engineering and the planned update to the Copperwood Feasibility Study.
Scientific and Technical Information

The scientific and technical information contained in this news release has been reviewed and approved by Trace Arlaud, a “Qualified Person” as defined under NI 43-101. Ms. Arlaud is a consultant to Highland Copper and serves as the Company’s Project Director.
About Highland Copper Company

Highland Copper Company Inc. is a Canadian company focused on exploring and developing copper project in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan, U.S.A. The Company has 739,158,985 common shares issued and outstanding. Its common shares are listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol "HI" and trade on the OTCQB Venture Market under symbol "HDRSF".
